P3 The reference-vs-live weighting is NOT O(eta/H). Under z-star the live face thickness is h_u(k) = e3u_0(k) * s_u with s_u a SINGLE per-column scalar (min_cell_to_uface of dz_ref*(1+eta/H) picks the same column at every k because dz_ref > 0), so s_u cancels exactly between numerator and denominator of the depth mean. The residual is therefore ROUNDOFF, not O(eta/H). item1_gyre_reference_vs_live_slow_forcin.non_vacuity: --plant adds 1.0 to the largest wet operand of the transplanted RHS; the reference arm must stop matching. A second, stronger control is the ARM SEPARATION itself: the reference arm is built from DIFFERENT operand arrays (NEMO's mesh_mask e3u_0/umask) than the live arm, so bitwise equality between them is a measured coincidence, not an identity of code.
item1_gyre_reference_vs_live_slow_forcin.measurable_limit_stated_up_front: kt=2 cannot be SCORED against a dumped GYRE slow_u frame because none exists. The kt=2 measurement is the reference-minus-live DIFFERENCE on the model's own kt=2 entry state, which sizes the claim; it is not an oracle comparison and will be labelled as such.
